overview: Modernized Python 3.10+ ASCII art movie streamer. It parses encoded frame files, renders VT100 output with a progress timebar, and delivers frames through stdout or a threaded TCP server exposed by the ascii-telnet-server console script.
graph:
pyproject.toml -> ascii_telnet_server.py (console script entry point ascii-telnet-server=ascii_telnet_server:main)
ascii_telnet_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_movie.py (Movie load for stdout mode)
ascii_telnet_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_player.py (VT100Player stdout playback)
ascii_telnet_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_server.py (ThreadedTCPServer/TelnetRequestHandler for standalone TCP mode)
ascii_telnet/ascii_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_movie.py (load movie per client connection)
ascii_telnet/ascii_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_player.py (play movie per client connection)
ascii_telnet/ascii_player.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_movie.py (TimeBar and movie dimensions drive rendering)
tests/test_cli.py -> ascii_telnet_server.py (argparse defaults and main routing)
tests/test_movie.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_movie.py (movie parser and placeholder frame contract)
tests/test_player.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_player.py (VT100 buffer and cursor bounds contract)
tests/test_server.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_server.py (server flags and disconnect handling)
tests/test_timebar.py -> ascii_telnet/ascii_movie.py (TimeBar behavior contract)
.github/workflows/tests.yml -> pyproject.toml (installs editable package with dev extra before pytest)
